source: kajisho5/video-production-agent src/video_agent/skills/contract.py (PR #7 head 9c2ae4a) — SkillPackage.validate() rules and ToolSpec fields
note: Rules of the consumer, copied once; the media-analysis contract under test is generated from the implementation, never hand-written here.

rules.skill_id_no_slash: skill_id must be a non-empty prefix without '/'
rules.at_least_one_tool: a package must declare at least one tool
rules.tool_skill_id_matches: every tool.skill_id equals the package skill_id
rules.tool_id_format: tool_id must be '<skill_id>/<name>' with exactly one '/'

tool_spec.kind_rule: kind is 'transform' when produces_output else 'measure'; media-analysis tools must all be 'measure'

observation.source_rule: '@' in source and not source.startswith('ai'); format '<tool id>@<version>' where tool id is '<skill_id>/<name>'
observation.provenance_rule: observations are OBSERVED tool measurements; AI output must carry AI_GENERATED and is never an observation

capability_names.rule: capability names are resolver names: 'ffmpeg', 'ffprobe', 'filter:<ffmpeg filter>', 'encoder:<name>'
